newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo NBY keeps discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Yugo NBY keeps discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) left its key discount rate for May unchanged at 2.5 percent per month, a central bank official told Reuters on Monday.
The NBY sharply cut its discount rate in March, following a slowdown in monthly inflation rates and stabilising monetary developments.
Inflation has been kept below one percent per month since February. The Federal Statistics said earlier today that monthly inflation fell to 0.1 percent in April from one percent in March.
The discount rate, NBY's key instrument in regulating market liquidity, was kept unchanged at 4.5 percent per month since June 1996.

The NBY sets its discount rate each month using a basket that includes interest rates on the open money market and its short-term bonds, price rises, expected monetary developments, credit demand and money supply. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
